purpose: The scoped V3 visual comparison map (ADR-0010). Migrated product screens and states get V3 comparisons here, each naming the owner-approved V3 reference it is compared with and the v46 comparison(s) it supersedes. Screens not listed keep their v46 checks and pins (tools/board-capture) unchanged; a superseded v46 comparison is retired by name, never counted as newly passed, never masked, never loosened.
rules: An entry is added only when a complete, owner-approved role export is integrated (pack prompt 11) and the screen state is migrated on the normal product build.

Each entry names: the V3 reference (export file, revision/hash, props or scenario), the product route and state, the widths, the method and tolerance, and the v46 parity comparison names it supersedes (or "none").
v46 pins (tools/board-capture/src/pinned.json), DEVIATIONS.md and BASELINES.md stay as history; superseded comparisons are listed under supersedes with the migration commit, not deleted silently.
Data may differ from a board fixture: the product binds its own records, so a comparison is made on a state whose content matches, or the difference is listed as content, not style.

productScreens.tolerance: No pixel tolerance is claimed: the export renders its own sample records (scenarios busy/new/quiet/konark), the product binds the sample world. The shell is the same V3 shell on both sides. Differences are listed under differences, never masked.
differences: “Renewal approved — the term isn't changed here” and “· access paused” are not drawn: the service holds no such facts.
productScreens.migration: Super Admin integration, branch v3/refined-b-ui, 19 Oct 2026

foundationEvidence.note: Not product baselines. The five supplied V3 boards were rendered with the HISTORICAL v46 canvas runtime (design/handoff-v46/runtime/support.js; compatibility with the V3 runtime not established; vendored React 18.3.1 / ReactDOM / Babel 7.29.0 from tools/board-capture/vendor; Public Sans from the Google Fonts link the boards name) next to the React specimens of the built harness (apps/specimens, next build) in the same Chromium, full page, device scale 1, reduced motion. Pixels count as different when a channel differs by more than 24.
foundationEvidence.result: All 44 board states (11 states × 4 widths) render at the board's exact page size. 36 are pixel-identical. The other 8 — the renewal (SA-03 ren) and paused (SA-03 kon) decisions, at every width — differ by 82 and 42 pixels (at most 0.006% of the page): two glyph pairs in one text run (‘contact person’), which the canvas runtime renders as separate interpolated spans. An earlier run of the same method during development (before the committed tool) found 33 identical and 11 with 42–6,903 text-rasterisation pixels (≤ 0.49%); the counts vary between runs as font faces load. No layout, colour or spacing difference remains after V3P-08.
foundationEvidence.run: 2026-10-18T19-14-27-074Z (UTC), harness built from this tree and served with next start; board page errors: none

productEvidence.note: Not baselines. Captures of the normal product build (next build + next start, port 3300) driven through the real UI by tools/v3-reference/capture-product.mjs, 19 Oct 2026, full page at each width, device scale 1, reduced motion; run folder tools/v3-reference/.runs/2026-10-19T10-17-32-253Z-product (git-ignored). The XS-08 inactive banner was captured on the test-hook build (fixture after-flow-d, the inactive Student per-0005) because the default product world holds no inactive person.
productEvidence.measured: 14 cases × 4 widths (60 captures with the My reports list) on the product build, plus the inactive banner × 4 on the test-hook build: no horizontal overflow at any width, no clipped text (visually hidden words excluded), Public Sans 400, 600, 650, 700 and 800 loaded on every capture, no console error. The paused banner was made through the real UI (the Super Admin pauses Deccan in SA-07, signs out, S. Kulkarni signs in); the banner is the first child of main at every width.
productEvidence.review: Every capture was reviewed side by side with the export render of the same state and width. The XS surfaces match the export (layout, type, colour, spacing, icons, focus treatment). Differences are the v46 shell around the in-shell surfaces (top bar, sidebar, the export's date line), the role-home page notices (pending), sample content, and the focus ring of an element that takes focus on arrival (the export renders it at rest).

entryPagePixels.method: The sign-in page is a full V3 page in both, so its four states are also pixel-compared with the export's width-matrix renders (a pixel differs when a channel differs by more than 24, as tools/v3-reference/compare.mjs).
entryPagePixels.result: Same page size in 15 of 16; what differs is glyph anti-aliasing (scattered text pixels, checked on a difference mask), the arrival focus ring of the error summary and the notices, and content: the session-ended notice names the capture's own return address (Institutions) where the export names a two-line course page, so at 375 its page is 46 px shorter. No layout, colour or spacing difference.

productEvidenceSA.note: Not baselines. Captures of the normal product build (next build + next start, port 3300) driven through the real UI by tools/v3-reference/capture-product.mjs (the SA_CASES), 19 Oct 2026, full page at each width, device scale 1, reduced motion; run folders tools/v3-reference/.runs/2026-10-19T15-09-15-984Z-product and 2026-10-19T15-14-42-707Z-product (git-ignored). The fresh product world holds no device transfer and no open support report, so SA-18 (Approved), SA-19 (approved DTR-0018), SA-20 and SA-21 (SUP-0213) were also captured on the test-hook build (fixtures after-flow-device and after-flow-e, the Super Admin booted) into the second folder (hooks-*).
productEvidenceSA.measured: 35 Super Admin cases × 4 widths (140 captures) on the product build (every screen, the no-match and unknown-record states, the Pause and Add area dialogs, the Menu drawer, PU-15 in the shell) plus 4 test-hook cases × 4 widths: no horizontal overflow at any width, no clipped text (visually hidden words excluded), Public Sans 400, 600, 650, 700 and 800 loaded on every capture, no console error, and no internal reference (REQ-, ACC-, UPD-, DTR-, SUP-, SUB-) in the page's words or accessible names — except one: SA-11 for UPD-0004 quotes the Content Manager's own seeded words “Correction UPD-0004.” (sample-world text, used by the Content Manager's tests; not a label the page makes).
productEvidenceSA.review: Reviewed side by side with the export renders of the same screen and width (overview, requests, institutions and an institution, content updates and a correction, all content and a record, structure, an area and a course, roles and a holder, device transfers and a transfer, support and a report, access ending, help). Layout, type, colour, spacing, icons and the shell match the export. What differs is the sample content (the product's sample world against the export's scenarios), the arrival focus ring the export renders on its focused H1, and the differences listed under each SA entry.
